name: Kavenga: Songs of the Star Path
storyline:
Setting out from the sacred home lagoon of Raʻiātea, you step into the barefoot role of a Polynesian wayfinder learning the ancient, unwritten art of open-ocean navigation. In a world without maps, instruments, or written logs, knowledge lives only in ancestral chants, ephemeral diagrams carved with a stick in wet beach sand, and night-sky vigils shared inside coastal stone rings. Sailing a traditional double-hulled voyaging canoe across shifting Pacific archipelagos, you must read rising and setting star paths, the four-beat rhythm of deep ocean swells, turquoise lagoon reflections under distant clouds, and the dawn and dusk flights of seabirds—earning
the trust of island elders, gathering sacred offerings, and uniting a crew of companions to carry your people's star-path lineage across uncharted horizons.
summary: Explore the vast pacific ocean, in this game of navigation without instruments. Inspired by the great voyages of the Polynesians, this game take the player on a journey from island to island, with no maps or compasses, relying instead on environmental cues, memorized chants, and the night sky for wayfinding. Playable entirely in the browser or in a tablet.
